pages.title: False Killer Whale
pages.text: The $(o)False Killer Whale$() ($(o)Pseudorca crassidens$()) is a large, slender, all-dark dolphin of warm, deep oceans, growing to about 6 metres.$(br2)It travels in large, sociable groups and hunts big fish such as tuna and mahi-mahi, often sharing its catch with others in the group.$(br2)Despite its name it is more closely related to pilot whales and Risso's dolphin than to the orca, which it resembles only in the shape of its skull.
